title: Event Dates
statementMd:
On a history lesson the teacher asked Vasya to name the dates when $*n*$ famous events took place. He doesn't remembers the exact dates but he remembers a segment of days $[*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}]$ (inclusive) on which the event could have taken place. However Vasya also remembers that there was at most one event in one day. Help him choose such $*n*$ dates of famous events that will fulfill both conditions. It is guaranteed that it is possible.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — the number of known events. Then follow $*n*$ lines containing two integers $*l*_{*i*}$ and $*r*_{*i*}$ each ($1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{7}$) — the earliest acceptable date and the latest acceptable date of the $*i*$-th event.

## Output

Print $*n*$ numbers — the dates on which the events took place. If there are several solutions, print any of them. It is guaranteed that a solution exists.
